theorems.name: Submission.coarea_normDet_horizontal_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ {V X Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [InnerProductSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [FiniteDimensional ℝ Y] (B : V →ₗ[ℝ] X) (L : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y) (Γ : V →ₗ[ℝ] Y) (K : Submodule ℝ V) (W : Submodule ℝ X), Function.Bijective B → (∀ v, Γ v = L (B v)) → K = LinearMap.ker Γ → W = (LinearMap.ker L)ᗮ → (Γ ∘ₗ Kᗮ.subtype).normDet = (L ∘ₗ W.subtype).normDet * ((W.orthogonalProjectionOnto : X →ₗ[ℝ] W) ∘ₗ B ∘ₗ Kᗮ.subtype).normDet
